purpose: Authorize a zero-cost independent exact-head code-review provider for public pull requests when Codex/Copilot review is unavailable, without weakening owner self-audit, exact-head, CI, thread, or drift requirements.
effectiveAfter: This governance manifest is merged to main. A separate implementation branch must then start from that accepted main and remain inside the finite path set below.
requiredInvariants: Octopus Review is an additional genuine independent provider; Codex and GitHub Copilot remain valid and owner self-audit never counts as independent review.
The Octopus action must be pinned to exact commit c7156c0dc465c20e8b06da84b92b64f9ae8c7c36; floating tags are forbidden in the accepted workflow.
No Octopus API key, signup, paid plan, secret purchase, or new recurring cost may be introduced; only the public-repository community tier is authorized.
The provider workflow must execute from accepted main authority and must not execute untrusted pull-request code.
The workflow token may have only contents:read and pull-requests:write permissions; source-code write, deployments, packages, secrets, actions administration and production permissions are forbidden.

Octopus evidence is acceptable only for the exact current PR head, only when the independent provider returns findings-count=0, and only when the provider workflow itself completes successfully on that same head.
A github-actions actor alone is never sufficient evidence; the verifier must require the dedicated provider workflow identity plus an exact structured Octopus attestation bound to the current head.
Existing exact-head CI, owner self-audit, unresolved review-thread, latest change-request and main-drift requirements remain mandatory and fail closed.
No MACHINE_FALLBACK, owner-posted provider PASS, arbitrary bot review, stale-head review, prefix-only authority, or fabricated independent evidence is authorized.
No registration, authentication, database, application-domain, PostHog runtime, REG.RU production, deployment or user-facing behavior is changed by this scope.
No new npm dependency is introduced; the provider action is invoked only by exact immutable GitHub Action commit SHA.
Standard GitHub-hosted Actions on this public repository may be used because they incur no new recurring cost.
